hero.title: Businesses built to operate differently.
body: Digit owns and manages a portfolio of businesses across e-commerce, media, marketing, web solutions, and software development.
The businesses are different. The operating idea behind them is the same: use software to take on more of the work, learn from what happens, and improve how the business operates over time.

portfolio.headline: Operating businesses changes how we build software.
portfolio.lead: A business gives the technology real work to do.
body: Markets move. Customers behave in unexpected ways. Processes break. New opportunities appear. Some ideas work and others do not.

Operating our own businesses gives Digit a direct way to learn from those conditions. The software has to deal with the same uncertainty, repetition, coordination, and decision-making that exists inside any real operation.
What we learn in the portfolio can shape what we build next.
portfolio.diagramNote: The portfolio gives the technology somewhere real to work. The results feed back into the software.

e-commerce.headline: Digital commerce built around better operations.
body: Our e-commerce work covers the systems behind discovering, developing, merchandising, distributing, and improving products.

That can include market and industry research, customer behavior, product development, pricing, merchandising, distribution, testing, performance measurement, and the operational work around keeping a commerce business moving.
Digit's technology is designed to support more of that work over time while preserving clear limits around spending, publishing, customer-facing actions, and other consequential decisions.
The category is intentionally broader than any single marketplace, storefront, or sales channel.

media.headline: Media businesses built for repeatable production and learning.
body: Digit's media businesses can span multiple media properties and formats without tying the company to a particular platform.
The work can include research, content development, production, publishing, distribution, audience intelligence, performance analysis, and the systems needed to keep a content operation moving.
Each property can develop its own audience, format, voice, and business model while sharing technology for the work underneath.
What performs well becomes evidence. What fails can still produce useful information for the next decision.

marketing.headline: Marketing built around testing and measurable results.
body: Digit's marketing work covers the systems behind customer acquisition, audience growth, creative production, experimentation, measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Research can inform strategy. Strategy can become campaigns and creative work. Results can be measured against the original objective. Useful findings can influence what happens next.
The focus stays on measurable business outcomes rather than activity for its own sake.

web-solutions.headline: The systems businesses depend on online.
body: Web Solutions covers the websites, applications, infrastructure, and connected services businesses use to operate online.
That includes websites, web applications, domains, hosting, integrations, business systems, and the infrastructure that connects them.
The work can range from public digital experiences to the systems behind them, with an emphasis on reliability, maintainability, and useful connections between software.

software-development.headline: Software built for real operations.
body: Software Development covers products and systems built around automation, intelligent applications, operational software, SaaS, agent-driven systems, and autonomous infrastructure.
Some software supports Digit's own companies. Other products can stand on their own.
The common thread is software that does useful work inside a business rather than existing only as a demonstration of the underlying technology.

closing.headline: The businesses give the technology something real to prove.
body: The portfolio is where ideas about autonomous operations meet deadlines, customers, costs, competition, and measurable results.
Those lessons go back into the systems Digit builds.
